scope: Synthetic users with separate cache scopes. Staff each authorized for one of 20 stores (4000 orders/store); admins authorized for all 80000 orders. Actual current order handler and SQL, simulated identity/authentication SELECT 1, Waitress32 / DB pool6 / isolated MySQL128MiB. Each user waits 5s AFTER response, synchronized cold starts. Mixed profile: 90% store-scoped staff and 10% full-dataset admins. Every6 requests:3 list,1 summary,1 search,1 next-page. 65s stages deliberately include keyword search and multiple cache expiry cycles. No real background jobs or external APIs. Closed-loop model underdelivers target traffic when slow.
